items.title: QBTS INVESTOR ALERT: D-Wave Quantum Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead Class Action Lawsuit, Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Announces
items.summary: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP announced a class action lawsuit against D-Wave Quantum Inc. for alleged securities fraud. The lawsuit claims D-Wave made false and misleading statements about its business prospects during the Class Period (February 26 - August 25, 2026). The case was triggered by disappointing Q2 2026 earnings ($3.08M vs. $4.03-4.08M expected) and the CFO's resignation announcement, both causing significant stock price declines.

items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of D-Wave Quantum Inc. - QBTS
items.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating D-Wave Quantum Inc. for potential securities fraud following disappointing Q2 2026 earnings results ($3.08M revenue vs. $4.03-4.08M expected) and the resignation of CFO John Markovich. The stock fell 9.28% on earnings miss and 9.51% on the CFO departure announcement.
